title: Write gate — unverified memory must not enter
Retrieval gate — poisoned samples never surface
Quality score & circuit breaker — alert only, never auto-delete
Incident ratchet — recurrence doubles the penalty
Raw transcript as ground truth — originals preserved forever
Trajectory distillation — failures become manual pages
Intent reconciliation — self-reported done is not done
Preregistered A/B — effectiveness is decided by tests
Behavior sequence monitoring — detect drift, not senility
Correction loop — close on user confirmation, no punishment for honesty
Conformance levels L1-L5 must be defined
Every number must trace to the source registry
